high_level_description: This image captures a dramatic scene of lightning striking during a thunderstorm at night. The sky is filled with dark, ominous clouds that are illuminated by the bright, jagged flashes of lightning. The lightning appears to be branching out in multiple directions, creating a dynamic and intense visual effect. The colors in the image are predominantly shades of deep blue and purple, which enhance the sense of power and drama associated with the storm. There are no visible people or objects in the foreground; the focus is entirely on the natural phenomenon of the lightning and the stormy sky.
